record_title: Global Hopf-slope balance for third-order feedback cycles and the Goodwin oscillator
provenance: An exact multiplier theorem for scalar third-order feedback equations, specialized to the three-stage Goodwin oscillator and extended to compactly supported invariant measures.
limitations: The identities are necessary rather than existence or stability theorems. Strict slope crossing excludes feedback that is affine with the critical slope on the oscillation range. Forger (2011) already contains the Goodwin period identity and lower bound. Classical sources not fully inspected remain a residual originality risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
